title: Bound on the configuration count
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$, and let $d,c,n$ be natural numbers. Set $r=2d(n+1)^c$, $H=3(|S|+1)$, $W=H+3k+1$, and $A=4dW+W+12kd+3k+2|S|+8$. Then $3(|S|+1)(n+2)3^{k(2r+1)}(2r+1)^k \le 2^{A(n+1)^{c+1}}$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
